breadcrumbs.$description: Tokens for Breadcrumbs: the trail from the site to the page (decision 47). Measured from the audit's captures of the property detail page (desktop 1700px, phone 400px) and the map search's list column.

font-size.$description: OBSERVED: 14px on the property detail page; 15px at the end of the search results list. One size now, 14px (decision 47).

gap.$description: OBSERVED: about 4px either side of each slash.

row-gap.$description: OBSERVED: wrapped lines sit directly under each other on the phone.

separator.$description: OBSERVED: an ink slash between the links (#000000 consolidated to ink).

current.$description: OBSERVED: the current page in grey (#63666a) on the property detail page; black on the search results. One colour now, the grey (decision 47).

background.$description: OBSERVED: the strip is #f9f9f9 on both pages.

border.$description: OBSERVED: 1px #dddddd lines above and below; became the system's default border (#e5e5e5). Decorative.

padding-block.$description: OBSERVED: 7px above and 3px below the text (property detail), 7px and 9px (search results); became 8px both.

padding-inline.$description: OBSERVED: 20px at 1700px and 400px; became the page gutter (16px).
